fields.help_en:
The storage class of the target table object. This parameter takes effect only when the target OceanBase database is version V4.3.0 or later, and either Schema Migration or Incremental Synchronization > DDL Synchronization is selected on the Select Migration Type page.

The available storage classes for the target table object include default (DEFAULT), row store (ROW), column store (COLUMN), and hybrid row-column store (COMPOUND). This parameter determines the storage class of the target table object during schema migration or incremental synchronization. For more information, see default_table_store_format (https://www.oceanbase.com/docs/common-oceanbase-database-cn-1000000002015561).

The default option automatically adapts to other options based on the target-side configuration. Specifically, table objects created during schema migration or new table objects from incremental DDL operations are written with the structure corresponding to the configured storage class
fields.help_zh:
目标端表对象存储类型。当目标端 OceanBase 数据库为 V4.3.0 及之后版本，并且在 选择迁移类型 页面选中 结构迁移 或 增量同步 > DDL 同步，该参数生效。

目标端表对象存储类型包括 默认（DEFAULT）、行存（ROW）、列存（COLUMN） 和 行列混存（COMPOUND），该参数用于确定结构迁移或增量同步时目标端表对象的存储类型，详情请参见 default_table_store_format (https://www.oceanbase.com/docs/common-oceanbase-database-cn-1000000002015561)。

默认 选项是根据目标端参数配置自适应其他选项，是结构迁移的表对象或增量 DDL 的新增表对象根据设置的存储类型写入对应的结构
fields.name: sink_store_format

fields.help_en:
The storage class of the source table object. This parameter takes effect when the source OceanBase database is version V4.3.0 or later, and Reverse Incremental > DDL Synchronization is selected on the Select Migration Type page.

The storage classes for the source table object include default (DEFAULT), row store (ROW), column store (COLUMN), and compound store (COMPOUND). This parameter determines the storage class of the source table object during reverse incremental synchronization. For more information, see default_table_store_format (https://www.oceanbase.com/docs/common-oceanbase-database-cn-1000000002015561).

The default option automatically adapts to other options based on the target-side parameter configuration. When reverse incremental synchronization is enabled, newly created table objects from incremental DDL are written to the corresponding structure according to the configured storage class
fields.help_zh:
源端表对象存储类型。当源端 OceanBase 数据库为 V4.3.0 及之后版本，并且在 选择迁移类型 页面选中 反向增量 > DDL 同步，该参数生效。

源端表对象存储类型包括 默认（DEFAULT）、行存（ROW）、列存（COLUMN） 和 行列混存（COMPOUND），该参数用于确定反向增量同步时源端表对象的存储类型，详情请参见 default_table_store_format (https://www.oceanbase.com/docs/common-oceanbase-database-cn-1000000002015561)。

默认 选项是根据目标端参数配置自适应其他选项，是反向增量时增量 DDL 的新增表对象根据设置的存储类型写入对应的结构
fields.name: source_store_format

fields.help_en: Specifies whether to synchronize the schema of the source data to the target. If enabled, an additional column is expected to be created on the target table to receive the schema name. The name of this column is specified by the `syncSchemaColumnName` parameter

fields.help_en: If the feature to synchronize the schema to the target is enabled, you can specify the column name to be synchronized to the target (the column must be pre-created on the target)

fields.help_en: Supported table types include ALL (all tables), WITH_UNIQUE_ROW_ID (tables with a unique row identity), and WITHOUT_UNIQUE_ROW_ID (tables without a unique row identity). The default value is ALL.

fields.help_en:
The policy for handling cases where the target table object contains records. Options include Ignore and Stop Migration.  
When set to true, it selects "Ignore": If the target table object contains data and there is a conflict between the existing data and the incoming data, Data Transmission Service logs the conflicting data and retains the original data unchanged during data ingestion.  
<notice>If "Ignore" is selected, full validation uses the IN pattern to pull data, which cannot validate scenarios where extra data exists on the target side, and validation performance is degraded to some extent.></notice>  
When set to false, it selects "Stop Migration": If the target table object contains data, full migration reports an error and does not allow migration. You must clean up the data on the target side before proceeding with migration.  
<notice>If you click recover after an error occurs, Data Transmission Service ignores this configuration option and continues migrating table data. Proceed with caution.></notice>
fields.help_zh:
目标端表对象存在记录时处理策略，包括 忽略 和 停止迁移。
设置为 true，表示选择忽略：当目标端表对象存在数据时，如果原数据与写入数据冲突，数据传输采用将冲突数据记录日志，保留原数据不变的策略进行数据写入。
<notice>选择忽略，全量校验将使用 IN 模式拉取数据，无法校验目标端多数据的场景，并且校验性能存在一定程度降级。></notice>
设置为 false，表示选择停止迁移：当目标端表对象存在数据时，全量迁移会报错不允许迁移，请处理好目标端数据后再继续迁移。
<notice>如果出错后单击恢复，数据传输将忽略该配置选项，继续迁移表数据，请谨慎操作。></notice>
fields.name: allow_dest_table_not_empty

fields.help_en:
Specifies whether to delete data from the target table when performing full migration for tables without a unique index on the source.  
Scenario: Multiple links from a PolarDB-X 1.0 database with tables lacking primary keys converge into the same target table. This avoids a situation where partial data from earlier links is erased by another link that truncates the target table immediately upon starting
